name: pulsechain-validator-analytics
description: Tools for PulseChain validators: the address a validator's withdrawal credentials name, and the PLS paid to validators over a date range

scripts.lint: eslint . --max-warnings 0 && markdownlint-cli2 && npm run format:check && github-actionlint .github/workflows/*.yml && npm run knip:files
scripts.audit:deps: npm audit --audit-level=high --omit=dev && npm audit --audit-level=high --omit=dev --prefix fetch-execution-address && npm audit --audit-level=high --omit=dev --prefix get-validator-payments
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run test:coverage && npm run audit:deps && npm run audit:security && npm run audit:secrets
